These character geometry files are copied from the existing MoyuBot desktop
character assets, originally from the ai girl bot project. Their upstream
license and attribution are retained in LICENSE.ai-girl-bot. See the main
repository's docs/ASSETS.md for provenance and use restrictions.

../sync.ts is generated from packages/core/src/sync.ts. Keep these files
identical when updating the replication protocol; the web app can then build
independently without depending on the desktop workspace.
